spans.s:
r. 4th cl. (with अनु prefixed) (अनुरुध्यते)
1 To desire, to wish for, to love.
2 To be kind to.
3 To consent, to concur.
4 To lament or be sorry for.
(ञि औ इर) ञि औरुधिर् r. 7th cl. (रुणद्धि रुंद्धे)
1 To impede, to oppose, to obstruct, to block or confine.
2 To invest, to blockade, to besiege.
With अभि and सम् prefixed,
To prevent.
With अव,
To guard.
With उप,
To blockade.
With प्रति or वि,
To oppose, to resist.
With सम् and नि,
To shut up, to surround or blockade.

Saffron.
m. (-रः)
The planet MARS.
E.
रुध to obstruct, किरच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-यी)
A Rākṣasa, a demon.
E.
रुधिर, and पायिन् who drinks.

ind.
Having stopped, checked, impeded, &c.
E.
रुध to hinder. क्त्वाच् aff.
